**Finding: LOL-CAP — compliant (sits at the fallback).**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** Paragraph 21.3 (p0242–p0245, mutual exclusion of direct/indirect lost profits and consequential loss), 21.1 (p0240, several not joint liability), 21.2 (p0241, mutual third-party indemnity limited to Schedule B share), 4.9 (p0126–p0127, PG exculpation for Supplier failure), 31 (p0270–p0274, confidentiality), 32.1/32.5/32.6 (p0275, p0279, p0280, pro-rata claim sharing). Targeted searches for "aggregate liability cap exceed", "wilful misconduct gross negligence", "limited to the amount", "shall not be liable" and "damages" returned no monetary cap and no carve-out list anywhere.

- **Why not a deviation:** mutuality is squarely satisfied (21.3 runs "any Party" to "any other Party"), and because no aggregate cap exists at all, indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct liability is already uncapped — the four fallback carve-out elements are met structurally. The only shortfall is a stated 12-months'-fees cap, which has no basis in a consortium construction and maintenance agreement with no vendor fee stream; Teleglobe's exposure is instead limited severally and to its Schedule B proportion.

- **Noted, not flagged:** no USD 1,000,000 floor, no "fees paid or payable" basis, no express Excluded Claims definition, and no payment-obligations carve-in — all preferred-only mechanics. Inserting an aggregate cap here would cut both ways in a symmetric multilateral regime, so we do not recommend opening it.
